responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines H8/300 control-flow patterns: conditional branches, unconditional jumps, table and indirect jumps, direct and indirect calls, sibling calls, and related compare-to-CC lowering. It is responsible for converting generic cbranch/call RTL into H8 branch and jsr/jmp forms with correct short/medium/long encodings, label handling, function-vector call syntax, delay-slot attributes, and post-reload splitting that materializes explicit CC compares when branches test ordinary operands or bit extracts.
